# Internationalization

i18next with HTTP backend loading from `public/locales/{lang}/{namespace}.json`.

## Supported locales (verified `ls public/locales/`)

`en`, `es`, `ja`, `ko`, `ru`, `zh-Hans`, `zh-Hant` — 7 languages.

## Namespaces (verified `ls public/locales/en/`)

`aic`, `app`, `dialog`, `domain`, `facility`, `item`, `onboarding`, `production`, `recipe`, `settings`, `structure`, `stats`, `targets`.

## Auto-generated vs hand-maintained

- `recipe` — regenerated by `pnpm run extract:recipes`. Sourced from `$ENDFIELD_DATA_DIR/TableCfg/FactoryMachineCraftTable.json` + `I18nTextTable_{LANG}.json`. Synthetic-recipe names (today: `liquid_clean_gate_1_*`) are preserved across re-runs via the `preserveExisting` merge in `scripts/lib/locales.ts`. **Do not hand-edit auto-derived entries.**
- `item` — regenerated by `pnpm run extract:items`. Sourced from `ItemTable.json` (`name.id` → `I18nTextTable_{LANG}.json`). **Do not hand-edit.**
- `facility` — regenerated by `pnpm run extract:facilities`. Sourced from `FactoryBuildingItemReverseTable → ItemTable.name → I18nTextTable_{LANG}.json`. Manual-facility names (today: `liquid_clean_gate_1` → "Sewage Inlet") preserved via merge. **Do not hand-edit auto-derived entries.**
- `aic` and `domain` — regenerated by `pnpm run extract:aic`. Sourced from `FacSTT*`, `FactoryBuildingTable`, `FactoryMachineCraftTable`, `ItemTable`, `DomainDataTable`. **Do not hand-edit.**
- `structure` — regenerated by `pnpm run extract:structures`. Per-region-structure + node names sourced from `FactoryBuildingTable.name` / `Factory*PlantStoreTable.name` → `I18nTextTable_{LANG}.json`. Nested shape: `structures.<id>` + `nodes.<nodeId>`. **Do not hand-edit.**
- All other namespaces (`app`, `dialog`, `onboarding`, `production`, `settings`, `stats`, `targets`) — hand-maintained.

## App-lang to game-lang mapping

```
en       -> EN
zh-Hans  -> CN
zh-Hant  -> TC
ja       -> JP
ko       -> KR
ru       -> RU
es       -> MX   (game only has Mexican Spanish; no PT-BR support yet)
```

## Helpers (`src/lib/i18n-helpers.ts`)

- `getItemName(item)` — `t(item.id, { ns: "item" })`.
- `getRecipeName(recipeOrId)` — `t(id, { ns: "recipe" })`.
- `getFacilityName(facility)` — `t(facility.id, { ns: "facility" })`.
- `getTransportLabel(item)` / `getTransportTooltip(item)` / `getInternalFlowLabel()` — production-namespace helpers for belt/pipe/internal flow labels.

## Data refresh workflow

Point `ENDFIELD_DATA_DIR` at the directory that contains `TableCfg/` (the
scripts read `$ENDFIELD_DATA_DIR/TableCfg/*.json`), then run every
extractor in dependency order (ids → facilities → recipes → items →
aic). Each subject can also be re-run on its own via
`pnpm run extract:<subject>`.

```bash
export ENDFIELD_DATA_DIR=/path/to/EndfieldData
pnpm run extract:all
```

The scripts fall back to a built-in default if `ENDFIELD_DATA_DIR` is
unset — see `scripts/lib/paths.ts` for the current value.

## Style conventions (hand-maintained namespaces)

- **No em/en dashes (`—`, `–`) in any locale string.** Rephrase with native punctuation instead: en/es colon or period; ru colon/period (yes, even though Russian likes тире); ja `。` split or `（）`; ko period or `()`; zh `：` / `，`. A full-branch sweep removed every one; a verification grep (`rg '—|–' public/locales -g '*.json'`) must stay empty.
- **CJK punctuation is full-width in prose** (`，` `。` `：` `（）`); half-width parens/colons only around pure Latin/numeric tokens (e.g. `({{used}} / {{cap}})`). zh-Hans quotes are `“”`; zh-Hant quotes are `「」`. Ellipsis is `…`, not `...`.
- **zh-Hant uses TW vocabulary**, not converted-Mainland forms: 預設/設定/傳送帶/新增/資料/目前/圖示/回饋/啟用/檢視 (vs 默認/設置/輸送帶/添加/數據/當前/圖標/反饋/啟動/視圖).

## Terminology (align to the official game glossary)

Verify terms against `$ENDFIELD_DATA_DIR/TableCfg/I18nTextTable_{LANG}.json` (id → text; find the EN id, look up the same id per language) before coining or changing one. Canonical picks (verified against game data):

| Concept | ja | ko | zh-Hans | zh-Hant | ru | es |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| facility (machine type) | 設備 | 설비 | 设备 | 設備 | сооружение | instalación |
| building (physical placement) | 建物 | 건물 | 建筑 | 建築 | здание | edificio |
| region | 地域 | 지역 | 地区 | 地區 | регион | región |
| AIC plan | 工業計画 | 공업 계획 | 工业计划 | 工業計劃 | АПК | CAI (masc.: "del CAI") |
| Metastorage | 無在庫転送 | 무재고 전송 | 超库存传输 | 超庫存傳輸 | Межхран. трансфер | Metaalmacenamiento |
| TTV | 総転送価値 | 전송 총가치 | 传输总值 | 傳輸總值 | ОСТ | VTT |
| Formula (recipe) | レシピ | 공식 | 配方 | 配方 | формула | fórmula |
| item | アイテム | 아이템 | 物品 | 物品 | предмет | objeto |

The facility-vs-building split is deliberate (facility = the machine type, building = a placed instance); don't collapse it in any locale. Calculator-coined terms with no game equivalent (e.g. prefill = 初期投入/사전 투입/预填充/Предзагрузка/Precarga) follow the established in-locale word once chosen.

## DO NOT

- DO NOT hand-edit `recipe.json`, `item.json`, `facility.json`, `aic.json`, or `domain.json` in any locale. Re-run the appropriate extract script instead.
- DO NOT add new namespaces without updating both `i18next.config.ts` and `src/i18n.ts`.
- DO NOT use `defaultValue` as the source of truth — every key should exist in at least the English locale. `defaultValue` is a fallback for missing keys, not a placeholder for unwritten translations.
- DO NOT introduce em/en dashes into locale strings — see "Style conventions".
- DO NOT coin a translation for a game concept without checking `I18nTextTable_{LANG}.json` first — see "Terminology".
- DO NOT add a key to one locale only. All 7 locales ship the same key set (plural-suffix variants excepted); the parity check is `python`-scriptable and was clean as of the terminology pass.
